Threat matrix: a) RFID/NFC tag cloning via SDR manipulation (HackRF One + GNU Radio 3.10 implementing EPC Gen2v2 replay attacks) b) Crowd-based visual obstruction tactics (PyTorch 2.1 pose estimation models triggering when staff FOV coverage <62%) c) Fitting room inventory diversion patterns (BLE beacon spoofing using ESP32-C6 with RSSI manipulation ±3.5dBm). Response window: 2hr to prevent mandatory SAR filing per 31 CFR §1022.320.'
